svg.title: netrunner-agents for Claude Code
svg.desc: A short looping launch film. A title card with eight pixel mascots, then Claude sending three subagents into a task, the pane updating live with tools, tokens and timers, one agent's activity opened up, the finished and flatlined rows, restyling an agent with a command, and finally all eight mascots with the install command.

g.text: Your Claude Code subagents, as tiny pixel mascots.
Ask for something big and it splits the job between subagents.
Checkout feels slow and I want the
On it, choom. Sending three agents in:
What each one is doing, how long, and exactly how many tokens. ~4 redraws a second, max.
One click shows its last tool calls, and later its final report.
Finished agents tuck into slim rows. Failures glitch, so you can’t miss them.
Checkout makes 14 price lookups one after another.
Batching them into one call should save ~600 ms.
final report, plain text, secrets masked
8 mascots, 7 colours, 9 bits of chrome. Any agent type, any combo.
a tiny, preem pane for Claude Code’s subagents
